scientific_purpose: Fit and persist the selected fresh CheMeleon plus four-primary-assay D6 readout as the validated two-seed five-bag margin policy, then score all 750 blind molecules. No incumbent scores, no fixed call count, no upload.
selection_rule: Choose the primary-supervised fresh CheMeleon learner: equal-seed combined held-out MCC .14530 UMAP/.23066 scaffold versus matched Morgan .12572/.16871 and class-only CheMeleon .13178/.21439. Use UMAP as routine deployment split, both prespecified seeds and learned bag cuts; no blind-output-based tuning.
limitations: Model/policy chosen after development inspections. Ten-model bag policy is evaluated inside untouched outer fitting boundaries but deployment bag models use 80 percent rather than 64 percent of development. Generic upstream 47-head ADME encoder original corpus manifest unknown; features are not prior challenge scores. Weak-primary D6 class outcomes remain unidentified; historical ensemble superiority on Live is not established.
